integrity: Proof is symbolic for all finite acyclic directed multigraphs; exhaustive independent code checks are finite corroboration, not a substitute for proof. Review is not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite directed acyclic multigraphs only; ordered commuting pairs including the zero element. Directed cycles invalidate the square-zero argument; the result does not address cyclic graphs or arbitrary commuting tuples. The historical-priority comparison cannot exclude unidentified equivalent formulas.
title: Path-matrix commutation census for finite graph inverse semigroups
